algorithm.title: Abnormal Screening Test for Congenital Hypothyroidism: Management.

cell.label: Abnormal newborn screen concerning for congenital hypothyroidism OR signs/symptoms concerning for congenital hypothyroidism.
Recheck TSH at 2–4 weeks. High TSH (>10 mU/L) and normal T4?
Pediatric endocrinology consult. Levothyroxine 10-15 mcg/kg PO daily. Trial off therapy at 3 years old.
Pediatric endocrinology consult. Levothyroxine 10-15 mcg/kg PO daily.

footnotes.footnote: *When on levothyroxine: (1) Adjust dosing to normalize TSH and maintain free T4 in upper half of reference range, and (2) Recheck free T4, TSH 2-4 wk after initiating levothyroxine, every 1-2 m in 1st 6 mo, every 3-4 m b/t 6 mo-3 y, every 6-12 m after 3 y.
Adapted from American Academy of Pediatric’s Update of Newborn Screening and Therapy for Congenital Hypothyroidism. Pediatrics 2006;117:2290-2303.
